# StegoRSA

**Link**: https://play.picoctf.org/practice/challenge/719

**Difficulty**: easy

## Description

A message has been encrypted using RSA. The public key is gone… but someone might have been careless with the private key. Can you recover it and decrypt the message?

## Resources
**flag**: encrypted message.

**image.jpg**: An image.

## How to solve

If we run

    exiftool image.jpg

We get information about the image, in particular in the comment section there is an interesting string

    Comment                         : 

By using those key we decryot the key and save it in a file and we give him the right permissions

    echo string | xxd -r -p > private_key.pem
    chmod 600 private_key.pem

Than by using

    openssl pkeyutl -decrypt -inkey private_key.pem -in file.enc -out file.dec
    
We decrypt the file using that key and we save it in a file `file.dec`
